title: Law to raise parking fines for big companies in city programs
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance to charge higher reduced parking fines to commercial organizations earning more than $10 million a year that participate in the city's stipulated fine and commercial abatement programs, with a sliding scale for those earning between $5 million and $10 million. Smaller participants would continue to pay a lower rate. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
